description: Read-only filesystem listing of a fixed set of user folders (Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Home), plus opening a file/folder with the OS default handler — backs the Files dock panel. No write access from this surface; the existing chat-driven create-file/create-folder tool (apps/api) is a separate, already-scoped path. shell:allow-execute below is a fixed, named allowlist of read-only diagnostic commands (whoami, hostname, ipconfig, systeminfo, tasklist, netstat, ver) with no user-supplied arguments at all — backs the Terminal dock panel as a diagnostics tool, deliberately not arbitrary/free-text command execution.
